_why: DECOY: same v4 layout, but the dex holds a near-miss passphrase (last char differs) -> the db never opens
generator_cmd: PYTHONPATH=tools/pysqlcipher3 python3 tests/data/android_fixtures/sqlc_src/gen_sqlc.py decoy_wrong_pw tests/data/android_fixtures/sqlc_decoy_wrong_pw.apk  # sqlcipher3-binary 0.6.0 (pip --target tools/pysqlcipher3, SQLCipher 4.12) writes the db; javac + d2j-jar2dex the dex
oracle_cmd: unzip -p tests/data/android_fixtures/sqlc_decoy_wrong_pw.apk assets/vault.db > /tmp/v.db; for pw in $(unzip -p tests/data/android_fixtures/sqlc_decoy_wrong_pw.apk classes.dex | strings -n 8); do PYTHONPATH=tools/pysqlcipher3 python3 -c "import sys,sqlcipher3,base64; c=sqlcipher3.connect('/tmp/v.db'); c.execute('PRAGMA key=\"'+sys.argv[1]+'\"'); print([base64.b64decode(r[0]).decode() if 0 else r[0] for r in c.execute('select body from notes where title=\"flag\"')][0])" "$pw" 2>/dev/null; done   # real SQLCipher (sqlcipher3) opens the db with each `strings -n 8` dex string
